title: 第11章 家主下场第12章 万家被灭
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
“林兄，咱两家都联姻了。”
“如今这台上，林家怎就不派人出手，去对付那苏铭？”秦家家主秦阳明，目光灼灼，直直看向林家家主林逸阳，话语中带着几分质问的意味。
林逸阳嘴角微微一勾，露出一抹歉意的笑容，不紧不慢地说道：“秦兄啊，实不相瞒。你家公子秦天霸都已遭不测，这婚约嘛，自然也就作废咯。”
“不过，咱林家也不是不懂礼数之人，为表心意，我这就派遣一位林家子弟上台。”
说罢，林逸阳大手一挥，只见一名凝气五层的林家子弟，昂首阔步走上台去。
那林家子弟刚站定，还没等苏铭有任何动作，竟直接拱手，高声喊道：“我认输！”
秦阳明见状，心中“噌”地一下，怒火直冒。他在这世上摸爬滚打多年，怎会看不懂林家这敷衍至极的把戏。
“哼！”秦阳明暗自冷哼一声，拳头不自觉地握紧，心中怒骂：“好你个林逸阳，竟如此敷衍于我！这口气，我秦阳明怎咽得下！等之后再收拾你林家！”
此刻，他的双眼仿佛要喷出火来，死死盯着林逸阳，恨不得冲上去，将其生吞活剥。
苏铭眼眸中满是傲然，目光如炬，蔑视四方，高声喝道：
“既无人上台，那这巅峰战第一，便非我莫属了！”
刹那间，四周议论声轰然炸开，众人纷纷咋舌。
“乖乖，这苏铭此前废柴十八年，竟藏了如此恐怖实力，简直深藏不露啊！”
“可不是嘛，谁能想到，这扮猪吃老虎的戏码，被他演绎得这般精彩！”
就在此时，一道倩影如惊鸿般掠上战台。此女正是苏家大长老苏凌虚的孙女苏紫寒，其身姿婀娜，肌肤赛雪，双眸灵动仿若藏着星辰，身着一袭淡紫色罗裙，随风轻摆，宛如仙子临尘。她站定后，朱唇轻启，声音清脆如铃：
“大少爷，请赐教。小女子也想领教一下大少爷这惊艳四方的实力。”
苏铭见状，眼神陡然一凝，心中暗自思忖：“原来此前在家族对我诸多不满之人，竟是这大长老，而非四长老、七长老。哼，这笔账，今日可得好好清算一番。”
念及此处，苏铭转身，看向自家老爷子，低声问道：
“爷爷，您看这事儿咋办？是直接废掉，还是……杀掉？”
此话一出，犹如一颗重磅炸弹投入人群，众人皆倒吸一口凉气。苏家大长老苏凌虚更是气得脸色涨红，怒声吼道：

“苏铭，你身为少家主，怎能如此对待自家人？简直荒谬至极！”
老爷子苏圣杰目光如电，冷冷开口：
“杀了。苏家，不需要有二心之人。”
大长老听闻，怒发冲冠，周身灵力瞬间暴动，直接爆发出通明境的强大实力，周身光芒闪耀，气势汹汹。
然而，老爷子苏圣杰冷哼一声，更强大的实力瞬间汹涌而出，仿若排山倒海一般，刹那间便将大长老的气势狠狠压了下去。
大长老只觉一股无形的巨力袭来，双腿一软，差点栽倒在地，脸上满是震惊与不甘。
“老爷子，何时如此强大了？”
苏紫寒眼眸如霜，冷冷睨向苏铭。
content_en:
"Brother Lin, our two families are married."
"Now on this stage, why didn't the Lin family send someone to deal with Su Ming?" Qin Yangming, the head of the Qin family, looked directly at Lin Yiyang, the head of the Lin family, with a hint of questioning in his words.
Lin Yiyang's mouth curled up slightly, revealing an apologetic smile, and said in a leisurely manner: "Brother Qin, I'm telling you the truth. Your young master Qin Tianba has suffered misfortune, so this engagement will naturally be cancelled."
"However, we in the Lin family are not ignorant of etiquette. To express our gratitude, I will send a member of the Lin family to the stage."
After saying that, Lin Yiyang waved his hand, and saw a disciple of the Lin family who was at the fifth level of Qi Condensation striding onto the stage with his head held high.
The Lin family boy just stood still, and before Su Ming could make any move, he directly handed over his hand and shouted loudly: "I give up!"
When Qin Yangming saw this, he felt a thump in his heart and became furious. He has been struggling in this world for many years, how could he not understand the Lin family's perfunctory tricks.
"Hmph!" Qin Yangming snorted secretly, clenched his fists unconsciously, and cursed in his heart: "You Lin Yiyang, you are so perfunctory to me! How can I, Qin Yangming, swallow this tone! I will deal with your Lin family later!"
At this moment, his eyes seemed to be spitting out fire, staring at Lin Yiyang, wanting to rush up and eat him alive.
Su Ming's eyes were full of arrogance, his gaze was like a torch, he looked down upon everyone around him, and shouted loudly:
"Since no one is on stage, then the first place in this peak battle must be mine!"
In an instant, the surrounding discussion exploded, and everyone was speechless.
"My dear, this useless Su Ming has been hiding such terrifying strength for eighteen years. It's so hidden!"
"No, no, who would have thought that the scene of pretending to be a pig and eating a tiger would be performed so wonderfully by him!"
At this moment, a beautiful shadow swept onto the battlefield like a thunderous giant. This girl is Su Zihan, the granddaughter of Su Lingxu, the eldest elder of the Su family. Her figure is graceful, her skin is as white as snow, her eyes are as smart as if they are hiding stars, she is wearing a lavender skirt, swaying in the wind, like a fairy on the dust. After she stood still, her red lips opened slightly, and her voice was as clear as a bell:
"Eldest Young Master, please enlighten me. The little girl also wants to experience the Eldest Young Master's amazing strength."
When Su Ming saw this, his eyes suddenly condensed, and he thought to himself: "It turns out that the person who was dissatisfied with me in the family was actually this elder, not the fourth elder and the seventh elder. Hmm, this account needs to be settled today."
Thinking of this, Su Ming turned around, looked at his old man, and asked in a low voice:
"Grandpa, what do you think we should do about this matter? Should we abolish it directly, or... kill it?"
As soon as these words came out, it was like a bomb dropped into the crowd, and everyone took a breath. The eldest elder of the Su family, Su Lingxu, turned red with anger and shouted angrily:
"Su Ming, as the young head of the family, how can you treat your own family like this? This is simply ridiculous!"
The old man Su Shengjie's eyes were like lightning and he said coldly:
"Kill. The Su family doesn't need people with second thoughts."
When the great elder heard this, he became furious, and the spiritual energy around his body instantly rioted, directly erupting into the powerful strength of the Transparent Realm. The whole body was shining with light and menacing momentum.
However, the old man Su Shengjie snorted coldly, and more powerful strength surged out in an instant, like an overwhelming force, suppressing the great elder's momentum in an instant.
The great elder felt an invisible force coming towards him. His legs weakened and he almost fell to the ground. His face was full of shock and unwillingness.
"Old man, when did you become so powerful?"
Su Zihan's eyes were as frosty as she stared at Su Ming coldly.
